purpose: Define optional conversion of an eligible DWH change record into an inert AIGMos Event, preserving exact CDC provenance before normal Trigger/Runner causality.

owns: DWH Change to Event Boundary semantics

topics.name: DWH Change to Event Boundary
topics.purpose: Define optional conversion of an eligible DWH change record into an inert AIGMos Event, preserving exact CDC provenance before normal Trigger/Runner causality.

flow: request downstream Runner/operation through normal dispatch
semantics.event_rule: Emitted Event has its own identity and references exact change-record/source revision identities.
semantics.payload_rule: Event payload is inert and schema-bounded.
semantics.binding_rule: Which change types/scopes emit Events is explicit.
semantics.causality_rule: Event→Trigger→Runner edges remain explicit and separate from DWH change identity.
semantics.authority_rule: A data change or emitted Event never grants downstream execution authority.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Same eligible change/binding does not emit duplicate semantic Event deliveries without explicit replay identity.
semantics.failure_rule: Event-emission failure is explicit and never rewrites the committed DWH mutation.

invariants.rule: DWH changefeeds expose committed mutation evidence as ordered provenance-bearing data/events; subscription delivery never directly executes downstream operations and never replaces the underlying record/revision identities.

hard_gates.condition: Event identity reused as change identity
event-emission failure rolls back unrelated committed write silently
same change emitted repeatedly without replay evidence

references.purpose: CDC may emit distinct inert Events.

prose.summary: Define optional conversion of an eligible DWH change record into an inert AIGMos Event, preserving exact CDC provenance before normal Trigger/Runner causality.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH mutation/persistence, Event causality, sync and remote-sharing contracts.
